shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git status --short && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && git log -3 --oneline"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && cat package.json && git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry names a wrong-typed property and expected type without returning its value$'"' --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo 'NO_REANCHOR_SCRIPT'; fi
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '25,58p'
git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m \"fix registry diagnostic test assertion\" && git push origin HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
